card.name: Patients before treated/who in warnings
card.fires_on: The word "patients" (or "who" after it) in fixed safety warning sentences, such as NSAID GI risk text, just before a phrase like "treated with" or "who develop". Also "pregnancies" after "All".

modes.label: NSAID GI warning
modes.description: "patients" or "who" in the stock sentence about serious GI events in patients treated with NSAIDs.
modes.example: These serious adverse events can occur at any time, with or without warning symptoms, in<< patients>> treated with NSAIDs.

modes.label: Group noun after quantifier
modes.description: A patient or pregnancy noun after "Most" or "All" that begins a statement about a group.
modes.example: Most<< patients>> who developed these infections were taking concom

card.writes: It slightly favors equals-sign tokens, which does not fit the text, so the output effect is unclear.
card.plain: It lights up on the word "patients" in standard warning sentences about who is affected.
